en: Old black‑and‑white street view postcard showing a sloping cobblestone street lined with shuttered houses and arcaded buildings, pedestrians and horse‑drawn carts. A stairway descends at right. The caption at the top is trilingual and identifies the place as Nagyszeben / Hermannstadt / Sibiu and the street as Burgergasse / Burger‑utca / Strada Ocnei. The reverse is a Hungarian-format postcard (LEVELEZŐ‑LAP) with a green 5‑fillér stamp canceled in Nagyszeben and addressed to Brassó (Kronstadt), with a handwritten German message.
